ideas.title: Free-tier fallback for Plus-limited core tools
ideas.note: Oct 13 current official pricing confirms ChatGPT Work and Codex included on Free with tighter usage and rollout-dependent desktop Luna; Codex Cloud and Sites are not included with Free. User reports Plus expires Oct 15. Preserve existing export and small local workflows; no new migration tool or urgent rebuild. Earlier note claiming Work unavailable on Free was stale.
